messages:
Maya (Design): quick spike — attached a mini-flow mock for the latency panel. goals: keyboard-first timepicker, persistent p95 pill while scrubbing, clearer sampling copy, and an optional patterned overlay for heatmap accessibility. figma: https://figma.com/... :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Liam (PM): neat. question—should the timepicker presets snap the scrubber to preset segments or just set range? if snap, keyboard users expect predictable jumps. also what default sampling when range > 24h?
Priya (Frontend): prefer snap-to-presets for keyboard. implementation note: scrubbing triggers many queries; propose debounce=100ms for pointer, 80ms for keyboard (keyboard usually slower). also avoid re-fetching full heatmap if only bucket offset changes.
Omar (SRE): debounce values sound reasonable. add client-side 1.8s smoothing for p95 during fast scrubs to reduce visible jitter. also telemetry: emit `viz.sampling_applied` and `viz.p95_sticky` events.
June (A11y): a11y checklist:
- timepicker presets must be tabbable and announce selection with aria-live
- scrubber must use role=\"slider\" with aria-valuetext: "From HH:MM to HH:MM"
- when sampling is active announce: "Sampling active: results may be approximate"
- patterned overlay: ensure toggle is accessible and described (e.g., "Colorblind overlay: dots")
Maya (Design): for copy i'm leaning to: label: "Sample rate" tooltip: "Applied to large ranges to reduce query cost; values may be approximate." short and clear. badge on p95: show `sampled` when sampling>0.
Liam (PM): agreed. show subtle banner when sampling auto-applies (text = "Sampling applied — results may be approximate") and a small `sampled` tag on p95.
Priya (Frontend): technical: backend will return `meta.sampled=true` with heatmap payload so we can toggle badge without extra calls. I'll wire debounce (pointer=100ms, keyboard=80ms) and smoothing=1.8s.
Omar (SRE): will add telemetry and a Grafana panel to monitor `viz.sampling_applied` occurrences. include reason tag (range/preset/rowcount).
June (A11y): i'll test NVDA + VoiceOver on the snap behavior and the aria-live messages. also confirm focus order: presets -> scrubber -> sampling control -> p95 pill.
ux-bot: created PR #5102: "timepicker-snap + sampled-badge + a11y-aria-live" assigned to @Priya and @June :robot_face:
Maya (Design): thanks all — next: Priya implements PR, June reviews a11y, Omar wires telemetry, Liam approves copy. i'll push final figma updates after PR lands :sparkles:
